messages:
ana: Following the postmortem today, I'm opening a short thread to assign owners and clarify handoffs for the cache/regional failover actions. Please claim or nominate alternates.

lee: thanks ana. can you paste the ticket ids + quick ACs?

ana: sure — created three tickets:
- RINF-4920: regional failover playbook updates. owner: UNASSIGNED. due: 2026-04-06. acceptance: documented failover steps for eu/us/apac + runbook drill verified in staging.
- RINF-4921: eviction policy audit + TTL defaults. owner: UNASSIGNED. due: 2026-03-29. acceptance: new TTL defaults deployed to staging, eviction spikes eliminated in 48h replay.
- RINF-4922: continuous bench harness + periodic regression job. owner: UNASSIGNED. due: 2026-04-12. acceptance: nightly regression triggers, alert on >5% perf regression vs baseline.

sam: RACI suggestion: Responsible = implementers (Tom, Lee), Accountable = Ana, Consulted = eng-sre (Nora), Informed = product, support. Thoughts?

lee: I'm OK taking RINF-4921 (eviction audit). will run a config matrix and log distributions. ETA: PR by 3/18, staging deploy 3/21.

tom: I'll pick up RINF-4920 (failover playbook). want to involve Nora for verification. ETA: draft 3/25.

nora: I can consult and own verification steps. for RINF-4920 i'll add automated checks and a canary gate. ETA verification scripts 4/01.

postmortem-bot: Postmortem doc linked: https://docs.internal.redwood.com/postmortems/2026-03-10-cache-failover-drc

ana: Quick policy: add the label "postmortem-action" + "recurring-incident" if you believe it's a repeat. We observed a repeating Tue morning spike for the last 3 incidents.

lee: adding recurring-incident to RINF-4921 and linking incidents 1723456789 and 1742504821.

sam: handoff plan: implementer (lee/tom) -> staging validation (nora) -> canary + rollout (tom) -> post-rollout verification (ana). please doc the handoff steps in each ticket with checkboxes.

lee: noted. also adding acceptance test: synthetic load that reproduces the spike + expected P95 latency < 200ms.

tom: for RINF-4920 i'll include a fallback policy in the playbook and a short checklist to escalate to on-call if canary fails.

nora: scheduler note: I'll create a recurring weekly triage for these labeled items and invite owners; prefer Fridays 10am.

ana: can we add a PI-level owner to ensure closure? propose: Sam (ops lead) to track and report weekly until all closed.

sam: can do. I'll run a closure sweep on Fridays and post a short status update in #postmortems.

lee: small technical note for RINF-4921: eviction seems correlated with sudden small-key churn when batch size increases >64. i'll include a test for batch size 128.

ana: good catch. include perf deltas in the ticket. Katie from QA should be a watcher — @katie can you volunteer to own test signoff?

katie: happy to. will add acceptance test steps and confirm regressions are covered.

postmortem-bot: Jira links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4920, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4921, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4922

lee: claimed RINF-4921 and set status to In Progress.

tom: claimed RINF-4920.

nora: added verification tasks to RINF-4920 and RINF-4921 and assigned to self.

sam: thanks. last process note: when you move to Done, attach the staging + canary logs and mark the ticket resolution with the exact regression numbers. otherwise I'll reopen. :slightly_smiling_face:
